title: $100M Leads
author: Alex Hormozi
blurb: Alex Hormozi argues that the biggest problem most businesses face is not their product but a shortage of interested people. He calls these people engaged leads. The book lays out four core ways to reach them: reaching out to people you know, posting free content, reaching out to strangers, and running paid ads. A key tool across all four is the lead magnet, a free and genuinely useful offer that solves a narrow problem and makes people want more. Once you have the basics working, Hormozi shows how to multiply your reach through Lead Getters. These are customers who refer friends, employees, agencies and affiliates who bring in leads for you. His message is simple and demanding. Do more of what works, do it better, and stay consistent long enough to see results.

lessons.t: Your Real Problem Is Not Enough Leads
lessons.b: Most businesses struggle because too few people know about them, so getting more engaged leads, people who show interest, is the first thing to fix.

lessons.t: Lead Magnets That Make People Want More
lessons.b: A strong lead magnet gives away a complete solution to one narrow problem, and solving it reveals a bigger problem your paid offer fixes.
